profile.name: BioShake 恒温振荡器
profile.description: 用于生物样品的加热与振荡装置，能够对振荡速度/加速度/减速度进行设置，并进行温度设定与控温；可对样品板（夹具/载板）进行锁定以保证运行稳定。
profile.description_en: A heater-shaker device for biological samples. It supports setting shaking speed, acceleration, and deceleration, as well as temperature setpoints with active temperature control. It can lock the sample plate/holder for stable operation.
